column3: “Found” is rendered “present,” and “until finished” as “until they had destroyed them all.” “Asherah poles” is rendered “Asherim.”
“According to the mouth of his service” is rendered “according to his service,” and “camps” as “camp.”
NASB supplies “He also appointed” and “namely.”
“Said” is rendered “commanded,” and “be strong in” as “devote themselves to.” NASB supplies “due.”
“As the word spread” is rendered “as soon as the order spread,” “multiplied” as “provided in abundance,” and “the first” as “the first fruits.”
“Holy things” is rendered “sacred gifts,” and “made heaps heaps” as “placed them in heaps.”
“To found” is rendered “to make.”
“Officials” is rendered “rulers.”
“Enquired” is rendered “questioned.”
“The priest the head” is rendered “the chief priest”; “we have had more than enough to abundance” is rendered “with plenty left over,” and the last clause as “this great quantity is left over.”
“Said” is rendered “commanded.”
NASB spells “Conaniah.” “In faithfulness” is rendered “faithfully,” and “second in command” as “second.”
“From the hand of” is rendered “under the authority of”; NASB supplies “was,” and “ruler” is rendered “chief officer.”
“To the east” is rendered “of the eastern gate,” and “holy things of the holy things” as “most holy things.”
“On his hand” is rendered “under his authority”; NASB supplies “their portions.”

The Hebrew reads “three years”; NASB reads “thirty years.” “Besides their genealogical enrollment” is rendered “without regard to their genealogical enrollment”; the meaning is uncertain. “The matter of a day in its day” is rendered “his daily obligations.”
NASB supplies “as well as” and “who were enrolled.”
NASB supplies “included”; “consecrated themselves holiness” is rendered “consecrated themselves faithfully in holiness.”
“In every city and a city” is rendered “or in each and every city.”
“Faithfulness” is rendered “true.”
Close to the Hebrew.
